<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. VII.|ACCORDING TO S. IOHN.|239}}</noinclude>{{hwe|tikes,|Schismatikes,}} Heretikes, or Apostataes, either for this Sacrament or any other Article, wil euer forsake Christ. And when company draweth vs to reuolt, let vs say thus: Lord, whither or to whom shal we goe, when we haue forsaken thee? to Caluin, Luther, or such: and forsake thee and thy Church with the vnfaithful multitude? No, thou hast the wordes of life, and we beleeue thee, and thy Church wil not nor can not beguile vs. ''Thou hast'' (saith S. Augustine) {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Tract. 27. in Euang. Io.''}}''life euerlasting in the ministration of thy body and bloud''. and a litle after, ''Thou art life euerlasting it self, and thou giuest not in thy flesh and bloud but that which thy self art''.

{{c|{{larger|{{sc|Chap. VII.}}}}}}

{{c|''The Iewes (of Hierusalem) seeking his death, he walketh in Galilee: where he signifieth to his brethren, that not in this feast Scenopégia, but in an other (to wit, Pasche folovving) the Ievves should kil him: that is, not vvhen they vvould, but vvhen he vvil. 10 In so much that at this feast he teacheth openly in the Temple, and conuerteth many, 14 both in the middle day 37 and the last day thereof, vvithout any hurt, though also the Rulers send to apprehend him.''}} {{dropinitial|A|image=Rhemes New Testament 1582 initial A, a bearded man.png|imgsize=115px|fl={{verse|chapter=7|verse=1}}}}FTER {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Tuesday in Passion weeke.}}these things {{sc|Iesvs}} vvalked {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`in Galilee,''}}`into Galilee', for he vvould not vvalke {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`in Iurie:''}}`into Iewrie': because the Ievves sought to kil him. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=2}}† And the festiual day of the Ievves, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Lev. 23, 34.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''Scenopégia (Leu.23 σκηνῶν ἑορτὴ'') is the ''feast of Tabernacles'', which the Iewes kept from the 7 octob. for eight daies together, by Gods commaundement, for a memorie that their fathers dwelt by Gods protection fourtie yeres in tabernacles or tentes, and not in houses, comming out of AEgypt. See Leuit. 23, 34.}}∷ Scenopégia, vvas at hand. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=3}}† And his brethren said to him, Passe from hence, and goe into Ievvrie: that thy Disciples also may see thy vvorkes vvhich thou doest. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=4}}† For no man doeth any thing in secrete, and seeketh him self to be in publike. If thou doe these things, manifest thy self to the vvorld. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=5}}† For neither did his brethren beleeue in him. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=6}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore saith to them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alvvaies readie. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=7}}† The vvorld can not hate you. but me it hateth: because I giue testimonie of it, that the vvorkes there of are euil. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=8}}† Goe you vp to this festiual day: {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`I vvil not yet goe vp''}}`I goe not vp' to this festiual day: because my time is not yet accomplished.

{{verse|chapter=7|verse=9}}† When he had said these things, him self taried in Galilee. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=10}}† But after his brethren vvere gone vp, then he also vvent vp to the festiual day, not openly, but as it vvere in secrete. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=11}}† The Ievves therfore sought him in the festiual day, and said, VVhere is he? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=12}}† And there vvas much murmuring in the multitude of him. For certaine said, That he is good. And others said, No, but he seduceth the multitudes. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=13}}† Yet no man spake openly of him for feare of the Iewes.⊣

{{verse|chapter=7|verse=14}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Tuesday in the 4 weeke of Lent.}}And when the festiuitie vvas novv halfe done, {{sc|Iesvs}} vvent vp into the temple, and taught. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=15}}† And the Iewes {{hws|mar|marueiled,}}<noinclude>{{rh|||ueiled.}}</noinclude>
